description: This file defines the 'ItemSelector' class for the Point of Sale module in ERPNext, handling item display, search, barcode scanning, and user interactions within the POS interface.

classes.name: ItemSelector
classes.description: Class managing item selection, display, search, barcode scanning, and user interactions in POS.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the ItemSelector with configuration parameters.

methods.name: inti_component
methods.description: Initializes component by preparing DOM, search bar, loading data, binding events, and shortcuts.

methods.name: prepare_dom
methods.description: Prepares the DOM structure for item display and filters.

methods.name: load_items_data
methods.description: Loads item group and price list data asynchronously, then fetches and renders items.

methods.name: get_items
methods.description: Fetches items from server based on search parameters.

methods.name: render_item_list
methods.description: Renders list of items in the container.

methods.name: get_item_html
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual item display, including image, name, and rate.

methods.name: handle_broken_image
methods.description: Replaces broken item images with item abbreviation.

methods.name: make_search_bar
methods.description: Creates search input and item group filter controls.

methods.name: set_search_value
methods.description: Sets the search input value programmatically.

methods.name: bind_events
methods.description: Binds barcode scanner, item click, and search input events.

methods.name: attach_shortcuts
methods.description: Adds keyboard shortcuts for search focus, item group focus, and selecting last filtered item.

methods.name: filter_items
methods.description: Filters items based on search term, with memoization for performance.

methods.name: add_filtered_item_to_cart
methods.description: Simulates clicking the filtered item to add it to cart.

methods.name: resize_selector
methods.description: Adjusts the layout of the selector for minimized or expanded view.

methods.name: toggle_component
methods.description: Shows or hides the item selector component.
